sn55.41:1.3: Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti ||
sn55.41:1.4: Iti pi so Bhagavā || la || satthā devamanussānam buddho bhagavā ti ||
sn55.41:2.1: Puna ca param bhikkhave ariyasāvako Dhamme ||
sn55.41:3.1: Ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi || la-pe || samādhisaṃvattanikehi ||
sn55.41:3.3: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro puññābhisandā kusalābhisandā sukhassāhārā || || 4.
sn55.41:4.1: Imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi puññābhisandehi kusalābhisandehi samannāgatassa ariyasāvakassa na sukaram puññassa pamāṇaṃ gaṇetuṃ
sn55.41:4.3: atha kho Asaṅkheyyo appameyyo mahāpuññakkhandho teva saṅkhaṃ gacchati || || 5.
sn55.41:5.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave mahāsamudde na sukaram udakassa pamāṇaṃ gaṇetuṃ
sn55.41:5.2: ettakāni udakāḷhakānīti vā ettakāni udakāḷhakasatānīti vā ettakāni udakāḷhakasahassānī ti vā ettakāni udakāḷhakasatasahassānī ti vā ||
sn55.41:5.3: atha kho Asaṅkheyyo appameyyo mahā udakakkhandho teva saṅkham gacchati || ||
sn55.41:5.4: Evam eva kho bhikkhave imehi catuhi puññābhisandehi kusalābhisandehi samanāgatassa ariyasāvakassa na sukaram puññassa pamāṇam gaṇetum
sn55.41:5.6: Atha kho Asaṅkheyyo appameyyo mahāpuññakkhandho teva saṅkhaṃ
sn55.41:8.4: najjo yathā vārivahā va sāgaran ti |||| 2.
